description: Manage the basic settings of this module here

content.name: give-roles-on-join
content.description: Roles to give to a new member

content.name: assign-roles-immediately
content.humanName: Immediately give roles, instead of waiting for rules acceptance?
content.description: If enabled, roles will be granted immediately when a user joins your server. Otherwise, no roles will be assigned to users before they complete the Discord onboarding.

content.name: treat-welcome-roles-as-base-roles
content.humanName: Treat join roles as base roles (auto-restore)
content.description: Guarantees every regular member has all roles configured under 'Give roles on join'. When enabled, the bot re-adds a join role if it gets removed, grants missing join roles after a member is released from quarantine or Join Gate hold, and runs a daily sweep to catch anything missed. Quarantined, held, and pending members are excluded — see the docs for the full list of exclusions and edge cases.

content.name: not-send-messages-if-member-is-bot
content.description: Should bots get ignored when they join (or leave) the server

content.name: give-roles-on-boost
content.description: Roles to give to members who boosts the server

content.name: delete-welcome-message
content.description: Should their welcome message be deleted, if a user leaves the server within 7 days

content.name: sendDirectMessageOnJoin
content.humanName: Send DM on join? (often experienced by users as spam)
content.description: If enabled, a DM will be sent to new users. This is often experienced by them as spam and can decrease your new user retention metrics. Please note that not all users will receive this DM, as a huge chunk has DMs disabled.

content.name: joinDM
content.description: Message that should get send to new users via DMs
